# SciNest · 科研小棉袄
> A Windows desktop research productivity application for deadline-driven students and early researchers who need to turn existing materials into editable academic writing, scientific figures and presentations.

## Site information
- Canonical site: https://scinest-ai.vercel.app/
- Default language: English
- Chinese page: https://scinest-ai.vercel.app/zh
- Operator: Jiaempower Pathways Limited, New Zealand
- Category: Research productivity software

## What SciNest is for
SciNest is designed for users who already have papers, references, notes, a partial draft, data, supervisor feedback or submission requirements, but still need to complete one or more academic deliverables before a deadline.

Typical tasks include:
1. Thesis and dissertation revision.
2. Literature review and research proposal workflows.
3. Revision from supervisor feedback.
4. Scientific figures, mechanism diagrams and research roadmaps.
5. Paper-to-PowerPoint conversion.
6. Editable thesis defense and academic presentations.

## Product difference
General AI tools usually return one answer or output at a time. SciNest keeps source materials, writing, figures, slides and project decisions connected so that work can continue across deliverables without repeatedly rebuilding the same research context.

## Output model
- Generated writing remains open to user review and editing.
- Scientific figures are intended to remain adjustable rather than being treated as locked decorative images.
- Presentation content and layouts are intended to remain editable.
- Users remain responsible for checking facts, citations, calculations, originality and final submissions.

## Product and pricing model
- SciNest Personal founding licence: ¥299 or US$49.
- Standard reference price: ¥399 or US$69.
- The founding licence includes 12 months of feature updates.
- The purchased version remains usable after the update period, subject to technical compatibility and the licence terms.
- AI model usage charges are separate and are paid to the model provider selected by the user.
- A 7-day trial is available through the current trial flow.

## Data and AI-provider boundary
- SciNest is designed as a local-first desktop workspace.
- Project files and generated outputs are stored locally by default.
- When an AI task is run, the content needed for that task is sent to the model provider selected and configured by the user.
- SciNest does not claim that every part of AI processing remains on-device.

## Intended users
Primary users are postgraduate students, final-year students and early researchers who already have academic materials but need to finish writing, figures or presentations under time pressure. SciNest is also relevant to non-native English academic users who want to continue editing and checking their own work.

## Important limits
- SciNest is not a thesis-submission, ghostwriting or academic-misconduct service.
- SciNest does not guarantee grades, graduation, thesis approval, publication, journal acceptance or research outcomes.
- SciNest does not guarantee that generated content is factually correct, complete, original or compliant with a specific institution's AI policy.
- SciNest does not claim guaranteed Nature, Science or Cell quality.
- Users must review generated work and follow applicable institutional, professional and legal requirements.
